textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Out in the Garden · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: The poem is about children playing in the garden on every fine day. With a ball, they bounce it, throw it and catch it. With a kite, they tug it, pull it and fly it.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: The poem is about children playing in the garden on every fine day. With a ball, they bounce it, throw it and catch it. With a kite, they tug it, pull it and fly it.
beats.speakEn: The poem is about children playing in the garden on every fine day. With a ball, they bounce it, throw it and catch it. With a kite, they tug it, pull it and fly it.

beats.en: Bounce means to spring back up after hitting the ground, as a ball does. Throw means to send something through the air with your hand. Sway means to move slowly from side to side, like a branch in the wind.
beats.speakEn: Bounce means to spring back up after hitting the ground, as a ball does. Throw means to send something through the air with your hand. Sway means to move slowly from side to side, like a branch in the wind.

type: Key Concept: The poem is about children playing in the garden on every fine day.
Rule: Bounce means to spring back up after hitting the ground, as a ball does.

beats.en: Children play many games, and the same game can have a different name in our mother tongue. When playing, we should take turns, play fairly and take care of ourselves and our friends.
